data.title: 贝塔 · 案前秉烛的夏目赶稿录
data.description: 四越地下编辑部的小阁间内。稿纸在暖炉案几上堆叠如山。贝塔抱着软绵绵的抱枕趴在桌前，咬着羽毛笔尾巴苦思下一章《暗影大人传记》的高潮段落，发梢微微散乱却充满狂热干劲。
data.location: cluttered cozy writer den with stacks of parchment, ink pots, and warm hearth glow
data.action: leaning over a low wooden writing desk hugging a soft plush pillow, nibbling the tip of a quill pen with messy silver hair, ink stains on fingertips
data.lighting: warm amber hearth light and a desktop brass reading lantern
data.mood: intense creative passion, adorable late-night disarray, devoted storyteller heart
data.promptProse: Beta in striped loungewear leans on a manuscript-covered desk hugging a pillow, biting her quill pen in late night writer inspiration.
data.animaCaption: Beta in late-night author mode hugging a pillow and chewing her quill over manuscripts.
